mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures at 64 degrees with clear skies over at Reddan Soccer Park, set under a lovely waning crescent moon.

In city news, the Verona Police Department reported the arrest of a 34-year-old Madison woman for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member. Additionally, road construction continues on Highway M for the new Aldi development, and bridge work is set to close a section of the Military Ridge State Trail starting this month.

Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow is a busy one for Verona with the downtown farmers market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and several trivia nights at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, and more.
On Friday, the Verona Police Department made an arrest of a 34-year-old woman in connection with an incident involving a school staff member reported in 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The Culver's of Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM, so make sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
